scientific_integrity: A complete analytic proof is provided. Finite computations check exact identities but are not evidence for the infinite-dimensional convergence. No external independent review or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the full real bivariate homogeneous polynomial coefficient spaces are treated; neither higher dimension nor complex scalars are included.
The limiting law is specified by a Gaussian-process supremum, without a closed-form distribution function or sharp tail asymptotic.
A prior equivalent boundary-scaled Kac-polynomial supremum limit might exist under different language; the searches reviewed did not establish it.
title: A Brownian Laplace limit law for real bivariate Bohnenblust–Hille ratios
